scalpComfortTarget.rationale: not_targeted: no SC1 unit. 'sanft zur Kopfhaut' is sparing/tolerance wording (E2a, protective); 'Ultra sensitiv ... sehr sensibler Haut' names skin, not the scalp, and the name word 'Sensitiv' alone never counts (SC1).
